name: opencode-delegator
description: Delegate text-heavy, low-reasoning Codex side work to the local opencode CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Hand text-heavy routine work to opencode.
interface.longDescription: OpenCode Delegator lets Codex call the local opencode CLI through MCP for large text reading, extraction, summarization, and other low-difficulty routine work while keeping the main Codex thread compact. It is opt-in only and is not used for multimodal tasks.
defaultPrompt: Use OpenCode Delegator to summarize these logs.
Ask opencode to scan these text files first.
Delegate this large extraction pass to opencode.
